ital1584-f153-154.summary: Guarna reports an audience with Duke Filippo Maria Visconti about Sforza's coming: the state in danger (enemies in the field, troops poorly provided, plague), 9,000 ducats, the gabelle and the troops at Cremona, then no more money for a long while; the Duke answered more openly than before and wants Sforza to come quickly.
ital1584-f153-154.en:
Read in part: 72.3% of the cipher words certain or probable. "…" = a gap (unresolved stretch). S.V. / Your Lordship = Francesco Sforza; "the Lord" / Signore = Duke Filippo Maria Visconti.

[153r, H] … to remedy these cursed troubles, of which … showing that he seemed … to serve … discontented … how I stand in this world on account of the dispatch [of your troops] … and since he did not see … what you hoped from Your Lordship … beyond comparison … so much that it had not been … in past days, and the reason was this: … in past days, that he was … only for the said reasons; but now, hearing that the enemies … through the countryside … to fear plainly that the state of … stood in great danger, very dangerous … of the state of … was intolerable, because when the matter of Your Lordship came … the state of … always … could remedy your affairs … that he should serve … towards Your Lordship.

system: Homophonic substitution with nulls, clear decoy words written inside the cipher (quia, adviso, tanto, mo, primum, tua, spes...) and a small code (A = Papa, cer = Signore, mea = non, tuy = gente d'arme, tri = Re de Ragona, SF = Signore de Faenza, dn =…
